title: Work In Progress shows an open internal work order with its badge and no value
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status In Progress, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours and one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 is listed with the "Internal" badge and no value.
  • Its value cells read "—".
